subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “It remembered a landscape that no longer existed.”?
options: Students made a display with old maps and current photos.
Students compared old maps with current ones.
The city archive had boxes of letters, photos, maps, and old government records.
Their teacher explained that old maps were made from limited reports, travel stories, and measurements.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「It remembered a landscape that no longer existed. Students made a display with old maps and current photos.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students compared old maps with current ones.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The city archive had boxes of letters, photos, maps, and old government records.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Their teacher explained that old maps were made from limited reports, travel stories, and measurements.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It remembered a landscape that no longer existed. Students made a display with old maps and current photos.」，答案為「Students made a display with old maps and current photos.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students made a display with old maps and current photos.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
